headline: Alvarez linked to Arsenal and Barcelona, no bid yet
paragraphs: Julian Alvarez's future at Atletico Madrid drew the most attention today. Atletico fans booed him during Sunday's draw with Villarreal, and BBC's gossip column, the Guardian and Sky Sports have all separately linked him with a move to Arsenal, with Barcelona floated as a second option. None of the three reports a bid or an agreement; Sky Sports's own video coverage frames it explicitly as open speculation on where he 'may end up.'

Manchester City's business is moving in both directions. BBC's gossip column, the only outlet running the story, now says City are ready to meet Chelsea's valuation for Enzo Fernandez. On departures, BBC and Sky Sports have both reported Newcastle interest in City's Nico Gonzalez, with Sky describing the move as more advanced. Liverpool's reported target Yankuba Minteh is harder to place: BBC has them weighing a third bid, while FourFourTwo separately reports Liverpool are already 'close to full agreement' on a fee -- the two accounts do not match.

Results were more settled than the transfer talk. Liverpool drew 2-2 at Newcastle on a stoppage-time Dominik Szoboszlai penalty that Sky Sports's Ref Watch column called contested, and Manchester City beat Bournemouth 2-1 under new manager Enzo Maresca, both per Opta Analyst. PSG came from two goals down to draw at Rennes, with Ferran Torres scoring twice off the bench on his debut, per the Guardian. Bayern's only mention was a Ballon d'Or piece on Harry Kane; Real Madrid appeared only in one unconfirmed FourFourTwo report linking them to an unnamed Arsenal player.
